title: CatalogReader
description: The catalog's query handler reads it only through `CatalogReader`, which the endpoint handler makes over the Tool and Loan repositories and hands to it. The catalog is kept in memory only: the reader builds it with the projection on each read.

title: OutcomeMeasuresReader
description: The outcome measures' query handler reads them only through `OutcomeMeasuresReader`, which the report makes over the Tool and Loan repositories and the outbox and hands to it. The measures are kept in memory only: the reader builds the month's row with the projection on each read.

title: ActiveLoansReader
description: The active loans' query handler reads them only through `ActiveLoansReader`, which the endpoint handler makes over the Loan repository and hands to it. The active loans are kept in memory only: the reader builds the tool's row with the projection on each read.

title: ToolsWaitingForRepairReader
description: The read model's query handler reads it only through `ToolsWaitingForRepairReader`, which the endpoint handler makes over the Tool and Loan repositories and hands to it. It is kept in memory only: the reader builds every waiting tool's entry with the projection on each read, from the tools that need repair (TL-LEND-SP04-PR), in tool ID order.
